integrity: The chamber-support and volume theorems of Bauer--Funke--Neumann and Bauer--Schmitz are credited as antecedents. Same-model mathematical review only; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Complex surfaces blown up at n>=7 distinct points of a smooth conic; counts chamber supports and volume finiteness, not individual numerical chamber volumes. Finite verification does not prove the unbounded-n case; the symbolic proof does. Historical priority not independently adjudicated.
title: Zariski-chamber polynomials for plane blow-ups at arbitrary numbers of points on a smooth conic
